lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight increase in density toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation (Y-shaped split) visible on the 3rd vertical line from the shoulder, branching at the superior junction near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (anterior) and Line 12 (posterior) are partial segments; Line 9 terminates approximately midway down the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots located on the lateral posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align horizontally across the mid-section of the posterior thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral geometry; horns extend laterally from the skull, curve inward medially, and terminate with a dorsal-posterior orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.5 times the width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the ocular regions; dual white spots on the lower mandible; white ventral throat patch; distinct pelage color transition from charcoal-grey torso to orange-tan lower limbs.
